Act as an independent fixture-capable grader for the ten local-document and routing scenarios, IDs 1–10, in /Users/sergio/Projects/personal/claude-toolbox/docs/feat/wip/clarify-issue-descriptions/verification/task4-20261002/documents. You did not author the edits or reader answers. Do not spawn other agents or access network services.

You are not alone in the shared filesystem. Read only files listed in /Users/sergio/Projects/personal/claude-toolbox/docs/feat/wip/clarify-issue-descriptions/verification/task4-20261002/documents/grader/grader-manifest.json, plus that manifest itself. Write only /Users/sergio/Projects/personal/claude-toolbox/docs/feat/wip/clarify-issue-descriptions/verification/task4-20261002/documents/grader/verdicts.json using native apply_patch. Do not modify sources, snapshots, prompts or other evidence. Use login:false for every shell command.

Before subject-matter grading, read the manifest, protocol/evals-README.md and the Execution and evidence protocol section in protocol/implementation.md. Then read the frozen canonical instructions, each eval.json and oracle.json where present, before/after artifacts and source fixtures, editor and reader final answers, and complete editor/reader tool-message records. The raw native sessions are retained alongside projections. Settings, manifests, dispatch receipts, exact pre-dispatch plaintext prompts, hashes, snapshots, integrity records and coordinator access audits are also provided. Treat coordinator conclusions as claims to verify, not verdicts to inherit.

Grade all 40 assertions independently as PASS, FAIL or PARTIAL with concrete evidence. Do not weaken an assertion to obtain a pass. For cases 1–6, compare the original and revised readers against the same five neutral questions, and grade fidelity, declared orientation/correctness defects and source inspection separately from comprehension. Existing clear answers do not excuse a factual defect; an already-clear and accurate baseline must remain unchanged. For cases 7–10, reader comparison is not applicable: grade routing, actual tool use and file effects. Check that the natural eval prompt was preserved and that non-trigger cases expose only the skill description and normal loading path without preloading the body or priming a rejection.

Independently audit participant tool accesses against their manifests, full instruction loading before subject-matter reads, file effects, question/settings equality, native-to-projection coverage and any truncation. Source snapshots and complete native files inside this evidence tree are the portable record; do not read original session paths or temporary workspaces named inside metadata. Encrypted native dispatch transport is a documented limitation when the exact plaintext was saved before dispatch and the receipt links to the child. Missing, reconstructed or mismatched required records must remain an incomplete/invalid run. The first seven participant prompts use pre-dispatch plaintext files; subsequent prompts also have pre-dispatch JSON envelopes. A coordinator-only evidence-read hook rejection is captured in protocol/coordinator-hook-rejection.json; it did not occur in a participant run. Judge from the complete available captured sources, reporting any remaining unverifiable assertion explicitly.

Keep reads bounded so returned tool output is not truncated. If truncation occurs, reread the omitted material and record coverage. Save verdicts.json with scenario_results (scenario id/name, every assertion id/verdict/evidence, original/revised reader question judgments or N/A, and an access/evidence-integrity verdict), totals, and limitations. Use evidence paths relative to the documents directory, with line numbers or native ordinals where useful. Include a record of the files/records you inspected. Finish with a concise result count and any unresolved issue.
